set.body:
Source: compressed review findings on non-atomic script staging and duplicated atomic-file logic.

Problem:
script staging can expose partial content, while worker/result/journal paths implement overlapping secure-write and atomic-move mechanics independently.

Acceptance:
- Stage scripts through create-new temporary files, explicit permission handling, force where required, and atomic move into the final name.
- Extract a narrowly scoped AtomicFiles primitive shared by compatible modules without creating dependency cycles.
- Define behavior when atomic move is unsupported and never silently downgrade durability.
- Add symlink, collision, partial-write, concurrent staging, and double-publication tests.
set.title: P6f.15: Make script staging atomic and share filesystem primitives
